To-Do List

A simple to-do list with task filters, completion checkboxes, deletion and clear-completed. Your tasks are saved in your browser and are still there on your next visit.

    No tasks yet — add your first one above.

    Your tasks are saved in this browser only, so they survive reloads on this device.

    📖 How to use

    1. Type a task in the input box and click "Add" (or press Enter).
    2. Tick the checkbox next to a task to mark it done.
    3. Use the filter buttons to view All, Active or Done tasks.
    4. Click "Clear completed" to remove all finished tasks at once.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    Where are my tasks stored?

    Your tasks are stored in your browser's localStorage on this device only. Clearing site data or using a different browser or device will start a fresh list.

    Do I need the internet to use it?

    No — the tool works fully offline once the page has loaded. All data stays on your own device.

    What do the All / Active / Done filters do?

    The filter buttons show All, Active or Done tasks so you can focus on what is left, while the counter always shows how many tasks are still active.
